changes.change: Qualify the existing real-valued VariableEnvelope.B used by rawFourth instead of the unrelated open-namespace B.
After the unchanged seven-mask case split and selection simplification, discharge the seven closed Nat.testBit propositions by kernel-checked decide.
Prove the existing same-value Fin.castLE/Fin.castSucc equality by Fin.ext/rfl and use it for the unchanged finite sum.
Allow the existing simp lemmas to reduce the three numeral Fin casts after unfolding thirdOwner and historicalPrefixProject.

manuscript.boundary: Original selected row permissions, inherited cap, same -2e and same selected joint cell are unchanged. Old15 remains an upper majorant; equality with the actual licensed fourth policy is not asserted.

reuse_scope: Existing definitions and proof-expression patterns were inspected; this note makes no new acceptance claim for those sources. No shared dependency was changed.
